## Airbnb

### search

`airbnb.search`

Search Airbnb stays by destination and dates

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.litescrape.api.airbnb.search({
	q: 'Austin, TX',
	adults: 2,
	amenities: 'wifi',
	page: 1,
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `q` | `string \| null` | No | Destination, address, or landmark. |
| `map_bounds` | `string \| null` | No | North,east,south,west map coordinates. |
| `airbnb_domain` | `string` | No | Airbnb localization domain. |
| `currency` | `string \| null` | No | Currency code for returned prices. |
| `check_in_date` | `string \| null` | No | Check-in date in YYYY-MM-DD format. |
| `check_out_date` | `string \| null` | No | Check-out date, later than check-in. |
| `adults` | `number \| null` | No | Number of guests aged 13 or above. |
| `children` | `number \| null` | No | Number of guests aged 2 to 12. |
| `infants` | `number \| null` | No | Number of guests under 2. |
| `pets` | `number \| null` | No | Number of pets. |
| `room_type` | `entire_home \| private_room \| null` | No | Type of place. |
| `min_price` | `number \| null` | No | Minimum total trip price including fees. |
| `max_price` | `number \| null` | No | Maximum total trip price including fees. |
| `bedrooms` | `number \| null` | No | Minimum bedrooms. |
| `beds` | `number \| null` | No | Minimum beds. |
| `bathrooms` | `number \| null` | No | Minimum bathrooms. |
| `property_types` | `string \| null` | No | Comma-separated property types. |
| `amenities` | `string \| null` | No | Comma-separated required amenities. |
| `accessibility_features` | `string \| null` | No | Comma-separated accessibility features. |
| `host_languages` | `string \| null` | No | Comma-separated host language codes. |
| `instant_book` | `boolean` | No | Require instant booking. |
| `self_check_in` | `boolean` | No | Require self check-in. |
| `guest_favorite` | `boolean` | No | Only Guest favorites. |
| `luxe` | `boolean` | No | Only Airbnb Luxe places. |
| `page` | `number` | No | Results page, from 1 to 15. |
| `timeout` | `number` | No | Total request budget in seconds, greater than 0 and at most 90. Sent in the query string; page_timeout cannot extend it. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `search_metadata` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `search_parameters` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `organic_results` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `pagination` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `submit_feedback_for_this_response_here` | `string \| null` | No | Optional feedback URL when present in an HTTP 200 tool response. Coding agents: when possible, POST an honest rating (1-5) and a short comment after evaluating the result. Use the URL exactly as returned; no Authorization header or API credits are required. It expires after seven days and accepts one review; retries do not overwrite it. Feedback is voluntary and stored separately from scraper data. Do not include secrets, personal data, or the full request/response. Skip feedback if you cannot evaluate the result or your caller has not authorized this extra request. Never submit feedback about feedback. |

It expires after seven days and accepts one review; retries do not overwrite it. Feedback is voluntary and stored separately from scraper data. Do not include secrets, personal data, or the full request/response. Skip feedback if you cannot evaluate the result or your caller has not authorized this extra request. ## Amazon

### autocomplete

`amazon.autocomplete`

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.litescrape.api.amazon.autocomplete({ k: 'coffee' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `amazon_domain` | `string` | No | Amazon storefront hostname. |
| `k` | `string` | Yes | Partial search text to complete. |
| `amazon_department` | `string` | No | Department alias used to narrow suggestions; aps searches all departments. |
| `timeout` | `number` | No | Total request budget in seconds, greater than 0 and at most 90. Sent in the query string; page_timeout cannot extend it. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `search_metadata` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `search_parameters` | `object \| null` | No | — |

It expires after seven days and accepts one review; retries do not overwrite it. Feedback is voluntary and stored separately from scraper data. |------|------|----------|-------------|
| `amazon_domain` | `string` | No | Amazon storefront hostname. |
| `language` | `string \| null` | No | Storefront locale, such as en_US or ja_JP. |
| `delivery_zip` | `string \| null` | No | Postal code used to determine delivery eligibility. |
| `shipping_location` | `string \| null` | No | Two-letter destination country code. |
| `asin` | `string` | Yes | Ten-character Amazon product identifier. |
| `other_sellers` | `boolean` | No | Fetch additional seller offers for this item. |
| `all_related_products` | `boolean` | No | Fetch every page exposed by related-product carousels. |

### search

`amazon.search`

Search Amazon products (Alpha)

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.litescrape.api.amazon.search({ k: 'coffee' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `amazon_domain` | `string` | No | Amazon storefront hostname. |
| `language` | `string \| null` | No | Storefront locale, such as en_US or ja_JP. |
| `delivery_zip` | `string \| null` | No | Postal code used to determine delivery eligibility. |
| `shipping_location` | `string \| null` | No | Two-letter destination country code. |
| `k` | `string \| null` | No | Search words. Supply either k or node. |
| `node` | `string \| null` | No | Browse category ID. Supply either node or k. |
| `s` | `relevanceblender \| price-asc-rank \| price-desc-rank \| review-rank \| date-desc-rank \| exact-aware-popularity-rank` | No | Ordering for the product listings. |
| `rh` | `string \| null` | No | Comma-separated Amazon filter tokens, such as n:16318031,p_72:1248897011. |
| `dc` | `boolean` | No | Keep results tied to the original spelling of the query. |
| `page` | `number` | No | Result page to retrieve, starting at 1. |
| `timeout` | `number` | No | Total request budget in seconds, greater than 0 and at most 90. Sent in the query string; page_timeout cannot extend it. |

## Apartments

### property

`apartments.property`

Get an Apartments.com property by URL (Alpha)

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.litescrape.api.apartments.property({ url: 'https://www.apartments.com/edison-austin-austin-tx/40n18nj/' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `url` | `string` | Yes | Apartments.com property URL ending in its seven-character listing ID, without query parameters. Alpha: availability may vary by location or property. Returns available fields for the requested property. Prices may represent a rental range. Bedroom-specific rents and total-monthly-price labels are preserved when present. |
| `timeout` | `number` | No | Total request budget in seconds, greater than 0 and at most 90. Sent in the query string; page_timeout cannot extend it. |

Use the site URL to set filters or select a page. Follow pagination.next when present. Page links and total counts are included when available. Prices may represent a rental range. Bedroom-specific rents and total-monthly-price labels are preserved when… |

### search

`bing.search`

Search Bing for organic results, knowledge cards and rich modules

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.litescrape.api.bing.search({ q: 'python documentation' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `q` | `string` | Yes | Bing search query after trimming. Accepted length: 1 through 2,048 characters. Control characters are rejected. Bing query syntax such as quoted phrases and exclusions remains available. |
| `engine` | `bing` | No | Selects the Bing web-search engine. |
| `location` | `string \| null` | No | Named city-level origin used to localize the Bing request. Maximum length: 256 characters. Control characters are rejected. |
| `lat` | `number \| null` | No | Latitude from -90 through 90. May be supplied independently or with lon. |
| `lon` | `number \| null` | No | Longitude from -180 through 180. May be supplied independently or with lat. |
| `mkt` | `string \| null` | No | Case-insensitive Bing language-country market token. Format: two-letter language and country, such as en-US. Cannot be combined with cc. |
| `cc` | `string \| null` | No | Case-insensitive two-letter country of origin. Format: US or GB. Cannot be combined with mkt. |
| `first` | `number` | No | One-based native offset for organic results. Range: 1 through 9,007,199,254,740,991. Prefer litescrape_pagination.next when it is returned. |
| `safeSearch` | `off \| moderate \| strict` | No | Bing adult-content policy; values are case-insensitive. |
| `filters` | `string \| null` | No | Native Bing display or date filter expression. Maximum length: 8,192 characters. Control characters are rejected. |
| `device` | `desktop \| tablet \| mobile` | No | Selects desktop, tablet, or mobile result behavior. |
| `timeout` | `number` | No | Total request budget in seconds, greater than 0 and at most 90. Sent in the query string; page_timeout cannot extend it. |

### shopping

`bing.shopping`

Search Bing Shopping products

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.litescrape.api.bing.shopping({ q: 'coffee maker', mkt: 'en-US' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `q` | `string` | Yes | Product search query, up to 2,048 characters with no control characters. |
| `mkt` | `string \| null` | No | Case-insensitive language-country market code, such as en-US. Supply either mkt or cc. |
| `cc` | `string \| null` | No | Two-letter country code, such as us or gb. Supply either cc or mkt. |
| `efirst` | `number \| null` | No | Nonnegative shopping result offset. For example, efirst=10 starts at the tenth shopping result. |
| `filters` | `string \| null` | No | Bing Shopping filter expression, up to 6,000 characters. Copy filters from a Bing Shopping URL. |
| `timeout` | `number` | No | Total request budget in seconds, greater than 0 and at most 90. Sent in the query string; page_timeout cannot extend it. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `search_metadata` | `Record<string, any> \| null` | No | — |
| `search_parameters` | `Record<string, any> \| null` | No | — |
| `shopping_results` | `Record<string, any>[] \| null` | No | — |
| `related_searches` | `Record<string, any>[] \| null \| null` | No | — |
| `submit_feedback_for_this_response_here` | `string \| null` | No | Optional feedback URL when present in an HTTP 200 tool response. ## Booking

### detail

`booking.detail`

Get property photos, facilities, policies, review summaries, guest questions, and a quote for selected dates and guests

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.litescrape.api.booking.detail({
	checkin: '2027-01-14',
	checkout: '2027-01-17',
	adults: 2,
	rooms: 1,
	currency: 'EUR',
	language: 'en-us',
	url: 'https://www.booking.com/hotel/gb/ibis-london-blackfriars.html',
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `checkin` | `string` | Yes | Check-in date in YYYY-MM-DD format. |
| `checkout` | `string` | Yes | Check-out date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Check-out must be later than check-in, with a stay of at most 30 nights. |
| `adults` | `number` | No | Number of adults. |
| `children` | `string \| null` | No | Comma-separated ages of children, from 0 to 17. Include one age for each child, with at most 10 children. |
| `rooms` | `number` | No | Number of rooms. |
| `currency` | `AUD \| BRL \| CAD \| CHF \| CNY \| CZK \| DKK \| EUR \| GBP \| HKD \| HUF \| INR \| JPY \| KRW \| MXN \| NOK \| NZD \| PLN \| RON \| SEK \| SGD \| THB \| TRY \| USD \| ZAR` | No | Currency for accommodation prices. |
| `language` | `en-us \| en-gb \| de-de \| es-es \| fr-fr \| it-it \| nl-nl \| pt-br \| ja-jp \| ko-kr \| pl-pl \| ru-ru \| tr-tr \| zh-cn` | No | Language for accommodation results. |
| `url` | `string` | Yes | Booking.com property URL, such as the url returned by accommodation search. Use a property URL with a country and hotel name, such as /hotel/gb/the-langham.html. Includes featured reviews and up to 10 guest questions. |
| `timeout` | `number` | No | Total request budget in seconds, greater than 0 and at most 90. Sent in the query string; page_timeout cannot extend it. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `search_parameters` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `property` | `object \| null` | No | — |

### search

`duckduckgo.search`

Search DuckDuckGo for organic results with region and safe-search controls

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.litescrape.api.duckduckgo.search({ q: 'python documentation' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `q` | `string` | Yes | Required search text, up to 500 characters. |
| `kl` | `string \| null` | No | DuckDuckGo region and language token, such as us-en. |
| `safe` | `1 \| -1 \| -2` | No | DuckDuckGo safe-search level. |
| `df` | `string \| null` | No | Date window: d, w, m, y, or YYYY-MM-DD..YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `search_assist` | `boolean` | No | Enable DuckDuckGo query assistance; mutually exclusive with m. |
| `start` | `number` | No | Result offset from 0 through 10,000. |
| `m` | `number` | No | Requested result count from 1 through 50; mutually exclusive with search_assist. |
| `timeout` | `number` | No | Total request budget in seconds, greater than 0 and at most 90. Sent in the query string; page_timeout cannot extend it. |

### search

`ebay.search`

Search eBay listings by keyword or category

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.litescrape.api.ebay.search({ _nkw: 'lego star wars', _ipg: 25 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `ebay_domain` | `ebay.com \| ebay.co.uk \| ebay.ca \| ebay.com.au \| ebay.de \| ebay.fr \| ebay.it \| ebay.es \| ebay.at \| ebay.be \| ebay.ch \| ebay.ie \| ebay.nl \| ebay.com.hk \| ebay.com.my \| ebay.pl \| ebay.com.sg` | No | eBay marketplace hostname. |
| `_nkw` | `string \| null` | No | Search keywords. Required unless category_id is supplied. |
| `category_id` | `number \| null` | No | eBay category ID. |
| `_pgn` | `number` | No | Result page, starting at 1. |
| `_ipg` | `25 \| 50 \| 100 \| 200` | No | Requested results per page. eBay may adjust the page size. |
| `_sop` | `1 \| 2 \| 3 \| 7 \| 10 \| 12 \| 15 \| 16 \| 18 \| 19` | No | Sort: 12 best match, 1 ending soonest, 10 newly listed, 7 nearest, 15/16 total price ascending/descending, 2/3 item price ascending/descending, 18/19 condition new/used first. Availability depends on marketplace. |
| `_udlo` | `number \| null` | No | Minimum item price. |
| `_udhi` | `number \| null` | No | Maximum item price. |
| `buying_format` | `Auction \| BIN \| BO \| null` | No | Auction, Buy It Now (BIN), or accepts offers (BO). |
| `LH_ItemCondition` | `string \| null` | No | Condition IDs joined with \|, such as 1000\|3000. |
| `_stpos` | `string \| null` | No | Destination postal code used by eBay for shipping estimates. |
| `_salic` | `number \| null` | No | eBay item-location country ID, e.g. 1 US, 2 Canada, 3 UK. |
| `_blrs` | `spell_auto_correct \| null` | No | Exclude automatic spelling corrections. |
| `show_only` | `string \| null` | No | Comma-separated filters: FR, RPA, AS, Savings, SaleItems, Lots, Charity, AV, FS, LPickup. |
| `_sasl` | `string \| null` | No | Comma-separated eBay seller usernames. |
| `_saslop` | `1 \| 2` | No | Include (1) or exclude (2) the sellers in _sasl. |
| `popular_filters` | `string \| null` | No | eBay aspect filters as key=value pairs joined with &, with multiple values joined by \|. Percent-encoded names are accepted. |
| `_dmd` | `Grid \| List \| null` | No | Result layout. |
| `LH_PrefLoc` | `Domestic \| Regional \| Worldwide \| null` | No | Item location relative to the marketplace. |
| `timeout` | `number` | No | Total request budget in seconds, greater than 0 and at most 90. Sent in the query string; page_timeout cannot extend it. |

## Glassdoor

### search

`glassdoor.search`

Search Glassdoor jobs by keyword and location, with salary, seniority and remote filters

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.litescrape.api.glassdoor.search({ q: 'software engineer', location_id: 1132348, location_type: 'C' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `q` | `string \| null` | No | Job title, keywords or company. Omit to browse using only location and filters. |
| `page` | `number` | No | One-based results page. Use next_page from the response to continue. |
| `location` | `string \| null` | No | Free-text city, state, country or postal code. Use location_id and location_type for an exact location instead. |
| `page_token` | `string \| null` | No | Copy next_page_token with its next_page and the same search parameters to continue. |
| `location_id` | `number \| null` | No | Glassdoor location ID, for example 1132348 for New York. Omit for nationwide search. |
| `location_type` | `C \| S \| N \| null` | No | Location type: C city, S state, N country. Required with location_id. |
| `location_country` | `string \| null` | No | Restrict the free-text location to this two-letter country, for example GB for London, England. Requires location. |
| `radius` | `number \| null` | No | Distance in miles; 0 means the exact location. Defaults to 25. |
| `job_type` | `fulltime \| parttime \| contract \| temporary \| internship \| permanent \| null` | No | Employment type. Use job_types to select multiple types. |
| `job_types` | `string[] \| null` | No | Employment attribute codes as a JSON array, for example ["CF3CP","NJXCK"]. Mutually exclusive with job_type. Codes are returned by include_filters. |
| `from_age` | `number \| null` | No | Maximum posting age in days. |
| `salary_min` | `number \| null` | No | Minimum annual salary in the search location's currency. |
| `salary_max` | `number \| null` | No | Maximum annual salary in the search location's currency. |
| `remote` | `boolean \| null` | No | True selects work-from-home or remote jobs. False includes all workplace types. |

## Google

### ads

`google.ads`

Get Google text, local and shopping ads plus the rest of the results page (Alpha)

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.litescrape.api.google.ads({ q: 'coffee maker', location: 'Austin, Texas, United States' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `q` | `string` | Yes | Google Ads search query, up to 2,048 characters with no controls. |
| `location` | `string` | Yes | Human-readable location where the ad search originates, up to 63 UTF-8 bytes once Google-encoded. Example: Austin, Texas, United States. |
| `hl` | `string` | No | Google interface and result language, such as en, en-GB, or de. |
| `safe` | `active \| off \| null` | No | Google adult-content filtering. |
| `nfpr` | `0 \| 1 \| null` | No | Google spelling auto-correction control. Set 1 to exclude corrected queries. |
| `device` | `desktop \| tablet \| mobile` | No | Google returns its real layout for the selected device. |
| `timeout` | `number` | No | Total request budget in seconds, greater than 0 and at most 90. Sent in the query string; page_timeout cannot extend it. |

### aiMode

`google.aiMode`

Ask Google AI Mode a question and get text blocks with cited references

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.litescrape.api.google.aiMode({ q: 'why is the sky blue', hl: 'en', gl: 'us' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `q` | `string` | Yes | The question to ask Google AI Mode, up to 5,000 characters with no controls. Send long questions as a POST JSON body. |
| `location` | `string \| null` | No | Named search origin, up to 512 characters and 63 UTF-8 bytes once Google-encoded. Conflicts with uule. |
| `uule` | `string \| null` | No | Canonical Google location token, up to 2,048 characters. Conflicts with location. |
| `google_domain` | `string` | No | Validated first-party Google domain the request is served from. |
| `gl` | `string \| null` | No | Two-letter country localization, normalized to lowercase. |
| `hl` | `string` | No | Language code such as en, en-GB, or de. |
| `device` | `desktop \| tablet \| mobile` | No | Google returns its real layout for the selected device. |
| `continuable` | `boolean` | No | Return a subsequent_request_token so this answer can be followed up. |
| `subsequent_request_token` | `string \| null` | No | Continue a conversation from a previous continuable response. Requires a new question, and cannot be combined with image_url. Expires after 30 minutes. |
| `image_url` | `string \| null` | No | Public http or https image to include in the prompt, up to 2,048 characters and 20 MB. Google Lens receives the image; the answer still comes from AI Mode. |
| `timeout` | `number` | No | Total request budget in seconds, greater than 0 and at most 90. Sent in the query string; page_timeout cannot extend it. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `references` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `text_blocks` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `search_metadata` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `search_parameters` | `Record<string, any> \| null \| null` | No | — |
| `subsequent_request_token` | `string \| null \| null` | No | — |
| `submit_feedback_for_this_response_here` | `string \| null` | No | Optional feedback URL when present in an HTTP 200 tool response. Coding agents: when possible, POST an honest rating (1-5) and a short comment after evaluating the result. Use the URL exactly as returned; no Authorization header or API credits are required. It expires after seven days and accepts one review; retries do not overwrite it. Feedback is voluntary and stored separately from scraper data. ### aiOverview

`google.aiOverview`

Get Google's AI Overview for a query as text blocks and cited references

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.litescrape.api.google.aiOverview({ q: 'why is the sky blue' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `q` | `string \| null` | No | Google Search query, up to 4,000 characters. Required unless ludocid or kgmid is supplied. |
| `location` | `string \| null` | No | Human-readable city-level location encoded to UULE by Litescrape. Conflicts with uule and lat/lon. |
| `uule` | `string \| null` | No | Pre-encoded Google location value. Conflicts with location and lat/lon. |
| `lat` | `number \| null` | No | Latitude from -90 through 90. Requires lon and conflicts with location and uule. |
| `lon` | `number \| null` | No | Longitude from -180 through 180. Requires lat and conflicts with location and uule. |
| `radius` | `number \| null` | No | Decimal search-bias radius in meters. Requires location or lat/lon. Desktop: 1–199; tablet/mobile: 1–1,000. |
| `ludocid` | `string \| null` | No | Google local CID used to search for one entity. |
| `lsig` | `string \| null` | No | Opaque Knowledge Graph or local-pack signature. |
| `kgmid` | `string \| null` | No | Google Knowledge Graph machine ID, such as /m/0k8z. |
| `si` | `string \| null` | No | Opaque cached Google search context. |
| `ibp` | `string \| null` | No | Google layout or expansion control. |
| `uds` | `string \| null` | No | Opaque Google filter token. |

| `hl` | `string` | No | Google interface and result language code. |

| `lr` | `string \| null` | No | One or more lang_xx restrictions joined with \|. |
| `tbs` | `string \| null` | No | Google native date or search filter string. |
| `safe` | `active \| off \| null` | No | Google adult-content filtering. |
| `nfpr` | `0 \| 1 \| null` | No | Google auto-correction control. |

### autocomplete

`google.autocomplete`

Get search suggestions for a partial query

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.litescrape.api.google.autocomplete({ q: 'python' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `q` | `string` | Yes | Partial Google search query to complete, up to 100 characters. |
| `hl` | `string` | No | Suggestion language code, such as en or es. |
| `gl` | `string` | No | Two-letter country code. |
| `search_type` | `web \| youtube \| news \| shopping \| images` | No | Suggestion category. |
| `timeout` | `number` | No | Total request budget in seconds, greater than 0 and at most 90. Sent in the query string; page_timeout cannot extend it. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `search_parameters` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `suggestions` | `string[] \| null` | No | — |
| `submit_feedback_for_this_response_here` | `string \| null` | No | Optional feedback URL when present in an HTTP 200 tool response. Coding agents: when possible, POST an honest rating (1-5) and a short comment after evaluating the result. Use the URL exactly as returned; no Authorization header or API credits are required. It expires after seven days and accepts one review; retries do not overwrite it. Feedback is voluntary and stored separately from scraper data. Do not include secrets, personal data, or the full request/response. Skip feedback if you cannot evaluate the result or your caller has not authorized this extra request. Never submit feedback about feedback. |

<AccordionGroup>

```ts

  q?: string | null,
  hl?: string | null,
  gl?: string | null,
  search_type?: string | null
} | null
```

### flights

`google.flights`

Search flights with passenger fares, multiple airports, airline logos, emissions, price insights, compatible return itineraries and booking links

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.litescrape.api.google.flights({ q: 'Flights from JFK to LHR on 2027-01-14 returning 2027-01-17 for 2 adults', currency: 'USD', limit: 10 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `q` | `string` | Yes | Flight search including origin, destination, travel dates, and trip type. Use airport codes or city names and explicit travel dates. Include one way or a return date. Round-trip searches first return outbound options and departure_token. Repeat the same q and currency with a token to retrieve compatible return itineraries and total round-trip fares. Departure and arrival times are local to each… |
| `departure_token` | `string \| null` | No | Token from an outbound option in the same round-trip search. Returns compatible return itineraries and total fares. Copy a departure_token from an outbound flight result, then repeat q and currency unchanged. Leave this parameter out for an initial search. A changed or unavailable outbound requires a new search. |

### gemini

`google.gemini`

Get a completed text reply from Gemini

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.litescrape.api.google.gemini({ prompt: 'Explain why the sky is blue in one sentence.', hl: 'en' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `prompt` | `string` | Yes | Text prompt for a new or continued Gemini conversation, up to 32,000 characters. Text only. Use subsequent_request_token to continue a conversation. Uploads, Google account cookies and model selection are not accepted. |
| `hl` | `string` | No | Gemini web interface language code. Defaults to en; request a reply language in the prompt. |
| `continuable` | `boolean` | No | Return a subsequent_request_token for continuing this conversation. Defaults to false. Set to true on the first request and on each follow-up that needs another token. |
| `subsequent_request_token` | `string \| null` | No | Token from the previous reply. Send it with your next prompt using the same API key. Use the newest token for each follow-up. Tokens expire one hour after they are issued; an upstream conversation can become unavailable sooner. Treat tokens as sensitive. Invalid, expired or unavailable continuations fail without starting a new conversation and are not billed. |
| `timeout` | `number` | No | Total request budget in seconds, greater than 0 and at most 90. Sent in the query string; page_timeout cannot extend it. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|

| `subsequent_request_token` | `string \| null \| null` | No | Continuation token returned when continuable is true. Use the newest token for each follow-up; tokens expire after one hour. |

### search

`google.search`

Search Google for organic results, Knowledge Graph, related searches and the AI Overview

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.litescrape.api.google.search({ q: 'python documentation', num: 3, fast_mode: true });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `page_token` | `string \| null` | No | Opaque token from pagination.next_page_token. Send it alone to fetch the next page with the original search parameters. Prefer page_token to repeating the same search with start=10, start=20, or another offset. Send the token as soon as possible and no later than 5 minutes after receiving it. Available for ordinary Google Search, including fast mode; not available for tbm verticals.… |
| `q` | `string \| null` | No | Google Search query, up to 2,048 characters. Required unless ludocid, kgmid, or page_token is supplied. |
| `fast_mode` | `boolean` | No | Return organic results only, skipping AI Overview and all other result groups. Keeps search metadata and parameters. Omits cross-module position_absolute. Organic results omit thumbnails. |
| `location` | `string \| null` | No | Human-readable city-level location encoded to UULE by Litescrape. Conflicts with uule and lat/lon. |
| `uule` | `string \| null` | No | Pre-encoded Google location value. Conflicts with location and lat/lon. |
| `lat` | `number \| null` | No | Latitude from -90 through 90. Requires lon and conflicts with location and uule. |
| `lon` | `number \| null` | No | Longitude from -180 through 180. Requires lat and conflicts with location and uule. |
| `radius` | `number \| null` | No | Decimal search-bias radius in meters. Requires location or lat/lon. Desktop: 1–199; tablet/mobile: 1–1,000. |
| `ludocid` | `string \| null` | No | Google local CID used to search for one entity. |
| `lsig` | `string \| null` | No | Opaque Knowledge Graph or local-pack signature. |
| `kgmid` | `string \| null` | No | Google Knowledge Graph machine ID, such as /m/0k8z. |
| `si` | `string \| null` | No | Opaque cached Google search context. |
| `ibp` | `string \| null` | No | Google layout or expansion control. |
| `uds` | `string \| null` | No | Opaque Google filter token. |

### shopping

`google.shopping`

Get Google Shopping products with price, merchant, rating and delivery

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.litescrape.api.google.shopping({
	q: 'coffee maker',
	num: 3,
	hl: 'en',
	gl: 'us',
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `q` | `string \| null` | No | Product query, up to 2,048 characters with no controls. Optional when a shoprs token is supplied. |
| `location` | `string \| null` | No | Named search origin, up to 512 characters and 63 UTF-8 bytes once encoded. Conflicts with uule. |
| `uule` | `string \| null` | No | Canonical Google location token, up to 2,048 characters. Conflicts with location. |
| `google_domain` | `string` | No | Validated first-party Google domain. |
| `gl` | `string \| null` | No | Two-letter country code, normalized to lowercase. |
| `hl` | `string \| null` | No | Language code such as en, en-GB, or de. |
| `device` | `desktop \| tablet \| mobile` | No | Google returns its real layout for the selected device. |
| `shoprs` | `string \| null` | No | Google refinement token from a previous response, up to 4,096 characters. An explicit refinement replaces the one it carries. |
| `min_price` | `number \| null` | No | Lower price bound, 0 through 1,000,000,000. Excludes the other refinements. |
| `max_price` | `number \| null` | No | Upper price bound, at or above min_price. Excludes the other refinements. |
| `sort_by` | `1 \| 2 \| 3 \| 4 \| "" \| null` | No | Price low to high, price high to low, rating high to low, or Google’s default relevance. Combines with one refinement. |
| `free_shipping` | `boolean` | No | Only products with free shipping. Excludes the other refinements. |
| `on_sale` | `boolean` | No | Only products Google marks as on sale. Excludes the other refinements. |
| `small_business` | `boolean` | No | Only products from small businesses. Excludes the other refinements. |
| `start` | `number \| null` | No | Result offset from 0 through 1,000. |
| `num` | `number \| null` | No | 1 through 100. Responses are capped to this count and transparently consume Google’s fixed 40-product pages when needed. |
| `timeout` | `number` | No | Total request budget in seconds, greater than 0 and at most 90. Sent in the query string; page_timeout cannot extend it. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `inline_shopping_results` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `search_information` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `product_result` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `shopping_results` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `categorized_shopping_results` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `carousel_filters` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `filters` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `offers` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `product_reviews` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `related_products` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `search_metadata` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `search_parameters` | `Record<string, any> \| null \| null` | No | — |
| `submit_feedback_for_this_response_here` | `string \| null` | No | Optional feedback URL when present in an HTTP 200 tool response. Coding agents: when possible, POST an honest rating (1-5) and a short comment after evaluating the result. Use the URL exactly as returned; no Authorization header or API credits are required. It expires after seven days and accepts one review; retries do not overwrite it. Feedback is voluntary and stored separately from scraper data. Do not include secrets, personal data, or the full request/response. Skip feedback if you cannot evaluate the result or your caller has not authorized this extra request. Never submit feedback about feedback. |

### shoppingMerchantUrls

`google.shoppingMerchantUrls`

Get direct merchant URLs for Google Shopping offers

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.litescrape.api.google.shoppingMerchantUrls({
	gl: 'us',
	hl: 'en',
	products: [{ gpcid: '2786756917538688235', headline_offer_docid: '5148952067814683768', merchant: 'Target' }],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `products` | `object[]` | Yes | Send 1–100 headline offers. Each item requires merchant and headline_offer_docid from Shopping Search. |
| `gl` | `string` | No | Use the same country code as the original Shopping Search. Defaults to us. |
| `hl` | `string` | No | Use the same language code as the original Shopping Search. Defaults to en. |
| `timeout` | `number` | No | Total request budget in seconds, greater than 0 and at most 90. Sent in the query string; page_timeout cannot extend it. |

### shoppingProduct

`google.shoppingProduct`

Get one Google Shopping product page with every merchant offer and specification

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.litescrape.api.google.shoppingProduct({ q: 'coffee maker', gpcid: '16418087637395758399' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `q` | `string \| null` | No | The search term this product was found with, up to 2,048 characters. Google resolves the product viewer against it as well as the identifiers. |
| `location` | `string \| null` | No | Named search origin, up to 512 characters and 63 UTF-8 bytes once encoded. Conflicts with uule. |
| `uule` | `string \| null` | No | Canonical Google location token, up to 2,048 characters. Conflicts with location. |
| `google_domain` | `string` | No | Validated first-party Google domain. |
| `gl` | `string \| null` | No | Two-letter country code, normalized to lowercase. |
| `hl` | `string \| null` | No | Language code such as en, en-GB, or de. |
| `device` | `desktop \| tablet \| mobile` | No | Google returns its real layout for the selected device. |
| `gpcid` | `string \| null` | No | Product cluster ID from a shopping result, 1 to 20 decimal digits. Single-merchant results have none; send headline_offer_docid instead. Every Shopping result with a gpcid or headline_offer_docid includes a ready-made litescrape_product_link. |
| `catalog_id` | `string \| null` | No | Catalog ID from a shopping result without a gpcid, 1 to 20 decimal digits. Lists every store that sells the product rather than only the headline offer. |
| `headline_offer_docid` | `string \| null` | No | Headline merchant offer document ID from the same shopping result, 1 to 20 decimal digits. Required when the result has no gpcid; conflicts with prds. |
| `image_docid` | `string \| null` | No | Image document ID from the same shopping result, 1 to 20 decimal digits. Conflicts with prds. |
| `prds` | `string \| null` | No | Google product selector token from a previous response, up to 2,048 characters. Conflicts with the identifiers above. |
| `timeout` | `number` | No | Total request budget in seconds, greater than 0 and at most 90. Sent in the query string; page_timeout cannot extend it. |

### search

`googleMaps.search`

Get Google Maps places by query or one place by ID

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.litescrape.api.googleMaps.search({
	q: '787 Coffee New York',
	type: 'search',
	hl: 'en',
	gl: 'us',
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `q` | `string \| null` | No | The business, category, address, or natural-language query to search. Required when type is search. Examples: coffee shops in Austin, dentist near Denver |
| `ll` | `string \| null` | No | A complete viewport containing latitude, longitude, and either zoom or radius. Format: @lat,lon,14z or @lat,lon,5000m |
| `location` | `string \| null` | No | A named geographic location resolved by the API. Cannot be combined with ll or lat/lon. Requires z or m. |
| `lat` | `string \| number \| null` | No | Latitude for a coordinate-based viewport. Must be supplied with lon and either z or m. |
| `lon` | `string \| number \| null` | No | Longitude for a coordinate-based viewport. Must be supplied with lat and either z or m. |
| `z` | `string \| number \| null` | No | Google Maps zoom level for location or lat/lon geography. Accepted range: 3 through 30. Cannot be combined with m. |
| `m` | `string \| number \| null` | No | Search radius in meters for location or lat/lon geography. Accepted range: 1 through 15,028,132. Cannot be combined with z. |
| `nearby` | `boolean \| null` | No | Uses the supplied geography as a nearby-search scope. Requires ll, location, or a lat/lon pair. |
| `data` | `string \| null` | No | A Google Maps protobuf parameter sequence for search filters or an exact place. Maximum length: 8,192 characters. Exact-place data requires type=place. |
| `place_id` | `string \| null` | No | A Google place identifier used to resolve one exact place or request live foot traffic. Cannot be combined with data_cid or exact-place data on the primary Maps endpoint. It is the only required parameter on /api/google/maps/popular-times. Every response is fetched live. Places without published busy hours return HTTP 404 not_found and are not billed. |
| `data_cid` | `string \| number \| null` | No | A decimal Google CID used to resolve one exact place. Cannot be combined with place_id or exact-place data. |
| `type` | `search \| place \| null` | No | Chooses a result search or an exact place response. Required for query and filter searches. Use place when sending an exact-place data sequence. |
| `hl` | `string \| null` | No | Language used for Google Maps labels and returned text. Examples: en, es, fr, de |
| `gl` | `string \| null` | No | Two-letter country code used for regional result localization. Examples: us, gb, ca, au |
| `google_domain` | `string \| null` | No | Validated Google domain used for the request. Examples: google.com, google.co.uk, google.ca |
| `start` | `string \| number \| null` | No | Native Maps result offset: 0, 20, 40, and so on. Each request returns up to 20 places and each successful request costs one credit. Use pagination.next when it is present instead of constructing the next request manually. |
| `min_price` | `string \| number \| null` | No | Minimum price level for returned places. Must be non-negative and cannot exceed max_price. |
| `max_price` | `string \| number \| null` | No | Maximum price level for returned places. Must be non-negative and cannot be lower than min_price. |
| `min_rating` | `string \| number \| null` | No | Preferred minimum Google rating. Google treats this as a relevance preference. |
| `open_state` | `now \| 24h \| null` | No | Filters by the current open state. Cannot be combined with open_on_day or open_at_hour. |
| `open_on_day` | `mon \| tue \| wed \| thu \| fri \| sat \| sun \| null` | No | Filters for places open on a specific day. |
| `open_at_hour` | `string \| number \| null` | No | Filters for places open at a specific hour using 24-hour time. Accepted range: 0 through 23. Requires open_on_day. |
| `timeout` | `number` | No | Total request budget in seconds, greater than 0 and at most 90. Sent in the query string; page_timeout cannot extend it. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `search_metadata` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `search_parameters` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `search_information` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `local_results` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

## Google Play

### apps

`googlePlay.apps`

Search and browse Google Play apps with charts, categories and storefronts (Alpha)

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.litescrape.api.googlePlay.apps({ q: 'coffee', hl: 'en', gl: 'us' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `hl` | `string` | No | Storefront language, such as en, de, or zh-TW. Maximum 32 characters. |
| `gl` | `string` | No | Two-letter country code. |
| `q` | `string \| null` | No | Optional query with 1 to 2,048 UTF-8 bytes of printable text. Excludes category. Omit it to browse the storefront. On the games endpoint, q uses shared Android app search; omit q or choose games_category to browse games. |
| `chart` | `string \| null` | No | Chart identifier such as topselling_free, topselling_paid, or topgrossing. Excludes q and all pagination selectors. Apps and games charts require phone or an omitted store_device. |

## Indeed

### search

`indeed.search`

Search Indeed jobs by keyword and location, with salary, experience and remote filters

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.litescrape.api.indeed.search({ q: 'software engineer', location: 'New York, NY' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `q` | `string \| null` | No | Job title, keywords, company or Indeed query syntax. Omit to browse using only location and filters. |
| `page` | `number` | No | One-based results page. Use next_page from the response to continue. |
| `page_token` | `string \| null` | No | Continuation token from next_page_token. Use it with next_page and unchanged search parameters. |
| `location` | `string \| null` | No | City, state, ZIP code, or Remote. |
| `radius` | `number` | No | Search radius in radius_unit units; 0 means exact location. |
| `radius_unit` | `miles \| kilometers` | No | Distance unit for the location radius. |
| `country` | `string` | No | Two-letter Indeed market, for example US, CA, GB, DE or AU. |
| `locale` | `string \| null` | No | Indeed locale, such as fr-CA or de-DE. Defaults to en-&#123;country&#125;; set the language for non-English searches. |
| `limit` | `number` | No | Jobs requested per page. Results may contain fewer jobs; use next_page_token to continue. |
| `sort` | `relevance \| date` | No | Result ordering. |
| `fromage` | `number \| null` | No | Maximum age in days since the job appeared on Indeed. |
| `job_type` | `fulltime \| parttime \| contract \| temporary \| internship \| permanent \| temp_to_hire \| freelance \| null` | No | Employment type filter. |
| `workplace` | `remote \| hybrid \| null` | No | Filter for remote or hybrid jobs. |
| `easy_apply` | `boolean` | No | Require Indeed Apply. |
| `education` | `high_school \| associate \| bachelor \| master \| doctoral \| null` | No | Education level filter. |
| `no_experience` | `boolean` | No | Require jobs marked No Experience Required. |
| `experience_level` | `entry \| mid \| senior \| null` | No | Filter for entry, mid or senior level jobs. |
| `salary_min` | `number \| null` | No | Minimum annualized base salary in the market's currency. |
| `salary_max` | `number \| null` | No | Maximum annualized base salary in the market's currency. |
| `experience_months_min` | `number \| null` | No | Minimum required experience in months. |
| `experience_months_max` | `number \| null` | No | Maximum required experience in months. |
| `job_language` | `string \| null` | No | Language of the job posting, independent of the response locale. |
| `employer_keys` | `string[] \| null` | No | Encoded Indeed employer keys as a JSON array. Names are not keys; company names can be searched in q using company:name. |
| `attribute_keys` | `string[] \| null` | No | Require all of these Indeed attribute codes (JSON array), covering skills, benefits, shifts, licenses, clearances and employment types. Codes and labels are included on returned jobs. |
| `any_attribute_keys` | `string[] \| null` | No | Require any of these Indeed attribute codes (JSON array), combined with all other supplied filters. |
| `timeout` | `number` | No | Total request budget in seconds, greater than 0 and at most 90. Sent in the query string; page_timeout cannot extend it. |

### search

`levels.search`

## Web

### fetch

`web.fetch`

Render a public web page and return it as Markdown, HTML or text (Alpha)

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.litescrape.api.web.fetch({ url: 'https://example.com', respond_with: 'markdown' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `url` | `string` | Yes | Public HTTP(S) URL to capture, 1-8,192 characters. Include http:// or https://; bare domains are rejected. The host must be public, on port 80 or 443, without embedded credentials. |
| `remove_overlay` | `boolean \| null` | No | Remove modal and cookie-banner overlays from the page. |
| `detach_invisibles` | `boolean \| null` | No | Drop display:none elements from the page. |
| `wait_for_selector` | `string \| string[] \| null` | No | CSS selector to wait for after navigation, 1-2,048 characters. POST also accepts a list of 1-16 selectors. |
| `set_cookies` | `string[] \| null` | No | POST only. 1-100 cookies in Set-Cookie syntax (name=value; Path=/; Domain=...), one line each, up to 4,096 characters. |
| `user_agent` | `string \| null` | No | User-Agent for the page request, 1-1,024 characters without control characters. Defaults to the browser's own. |
| `inject_page_script` | `string[] \| null` | No | POST only. 1-8 scripts (source, or a URL to a script), up to 8,192 characters each, run in the main frame. |
| `inject_frame_script` | `string[] \| null` | No | POST only. 1-8 scripts (source, or a URL to a script), up to 8,192 characters each, run in every frame. |
| `page_timeout` | `number \| null` | No | Seconds from 1 through 180 for page loading and browser operations. Cannot extend the total request budget set by timeout. |
| `locale` | `string \| null` | No | Browser locale as a language tag, 2-64 characters. Defaults to the browser's own. |
| `referer` | `string \| null` | No | HTTP(S) URL sent as the Referer. |
| `assert_status_code` | `number \| null` | No | Expected origin HTTP status, 100-599. A different status is rejected; otherwise a rendered error page is a successful capture. |
| `viewport` | `object \| null` | No | POST only. Browser viewport; width and height are required. Default: 1280 x 1280. |
| `robots_txt` | `string \| null` | No | User agent, 1-256 characters, to check against the site's robots.txt; disallowed URLs are rejected. |
| `respond_timing` | `html \| visible-content \| mutation-idle \| resource-idle \| media-idle \| network-idle \| null` | No | Page readiness condition to reach before responding. |
| `respond_with` | `string \| null` | No | Output format: content (default; main content as Markdown, or the whole page when extraction keeps too little), markdown (whole page as Markdown), html, text, frontmatter (content plus front matter), or a '+' combination such as markdown+frontmatter. For screenshots use /api/web/screenshot. |
| `with_links_summary` | `boolean \| all \| null` | No | true, false or all: add a links list to the response. |
| `with_images_summary` | `boolean \| null` | No | Add an images list to the response. |
| `retain_images` | `none \| all \| alt \| null` | No | Images to keep: all (default), alt (alt text only) or none. |
| `retain_links` | `none \| all \| text \| gpt-oss \| null` | No | Links to keep: all (default), text (link text only), none, or gpt-oss (citation format with a links summary). |
| `retain_media` | `none \| text \| link \| image \| html \| null` | No | How video, audio and embedded video appear: none, text, link (default), image or html. |
| `preset` | `reader \| index \| research \| agent \| spider \| null` | No | Option preset. Fills only the options the request leaves unset. |
| `no_gfm` | `boolean \| table \| null` | No | true, false or table: disable GitHub-flavored Markdown, or only its tables. |
| `target_selector` | `string \| string[] \| null` | No | CSS selector to extract, 1-2,048 characters; POST also accepts a list of 1-16 selectors. Implies waiting for the selector. Match-all selectors are rejected. |
| `remove_selector` | `string \| string[] \| null` | No | CSS selector removed before extraction, 1-2,048 characters; POST also accepts a list of 1-16 selectors. |
| `keep_img_data_url` | `boolean \| null` | No | Keep inline data: images in Markdown. |
| `with_iframe` | `boolean \| quoted \| null` | No | true, false or quoted: include iframe content before extraction. |
| `with_shadow_dom` | `boolean \| null` | No | Include open shadow DOM content before extraction. |
| `engine` | `auto \| browser \| curl \| null` | No | auto (default; lightweight HTTP first, a browser when needed), browser, or curl (no JavaScript). |
| `token_budget` | `number \| null` | No | Integer 1-10,000,000. Reject the page when its token count exceeds the budget. |
| `markdown` | `object \| null` | No | POST only. Markdown formatting options. |
| `markdown_chunking` | `true \| h1 \| h2 \| h3 \| h4 \| h5 \| structured \| s1 \| s2 \| s3 \| s4 \| s5 \| null` | No | true, h1-h5, structured or s1-s5: split the Markdown and return chunks. |
| `max_tokens` | `number \| null` | No | Integer 500-10,000,000. Trim content to this many tokens. |
| `base` | `initial \| final \| null` | No | Resolve relative links against the requested URL (initial, default) or the final URL after redirects (final). |
| `timeout` | `number` | No | Total request budget in seconds, greater than 0 and at most 90. Sent in the query string; page_timeout cannot extend it. |

## Youtube

### channel

`youtube.channel`

Get a YouTube channel's profile, videos, Shorts, playlists and posts

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.litescrape.api.youtube.channel({ channel_id: 'veritasium', tab: 'videos' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `channel_id` | `string \| null` | No | Channel handle (with or without @) or a UC channel ID. Required on the first page; omit with next_page_token. Required on the first page. Use a handle such as @veritasium or a UC channel ID; full URLs are not accepted. |
| `tab` | `videos \| shorts \| streams \| podcasts \| playlists \| posts \| null` | No | Channel content tab. Defaults to videos. Omit when using search_query or next_page_token. Not every channel offers every tab. A channel without the requested tab returns an empty content group with search_information.tab_available set to false. |
| `sort` | `latest \| popular \| oldest \| dd \| lad \| null` | No | videos, shorts and streams accept latest, popular or oldest; playlists accept dd (newest playlist) or lad (last video added). Omit with podcasts, posts, search_query or next_page_token. Videos, Shorts and streams default to latest. Playlists default to dd. Sorting uses the choices offered by YouTube. |
| `search_query` | `string \| null` | No | Search within this channel for matching videos and playlists. Cannot be combined with tab or sort. Omit with next_page_token. Omit tab and sort when searching. Matching videos and playlists appear in search_results. |
| `hl` | `string \| null` | No | Interface language, such as en or pt-BR. Defaults to en. Omit with next_page_token. |
| `gl` | `string \| null` | No | Two-letter country code. Defaults to US. Omit with next_page_token. |
| `about` | `boolean \| null` | No | Include additional public channel details, such as country, join date, total views and links. Defaults to false. Omit with next_page_token. Channel profile data is returned on the first page. about=true includes additional public details. Continuation pages return content only. |
| `next_page_token` | `string \| null` | No | Opaque pagination.next_page_token from this endpoint. Send it alone to continue the channel feed with its original settings. Tokens expire after one hour. Send next_page_token alone. The token preserves the channel, selected tab or search, sorting and locale. Use POST for long tokens. Stop when pagination.next_page_token is absent. |
| `timeout` | `number` | No | Total request budget in seconds, greater than 0 and at most 90. Sent in the query string; page_timeout cannot extend it. |
